secrets.name: AI_API_KEY
secrets.description: API key for your AI provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint). Get it from your provider's dashboard (e.g. platform.openai.com/api-keys).

secrets.name: AI_API_BASE_URL
secrets.description: Base URL for the AI API. Defaults to https://api.openai.com/v1. Change for OpenAI-compatible providers (e.g. https://api.anthropic.com/v1).

secrets.name: AI_MODEL
secrets.description: Model name to use (e.g. gpt-4o, claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022). Defaults to gpt-4o.
